listings.title: Magnesium Complex 15-in-1 for Men 1,000 mg Per Serving, 240 Softgels
bullets: Micro Ingredients offers a Magnesium Complex for Men, featuring a 15-in-1 formula delivering 1,000 mg per serving, combining 12 magnesium forms including glycinate, citrate, malate, and taurate, with vitamin B6, ashwagandha, and L-theanine, in easy-to-swallow softgels.
Each pouch contains 240 softgels, providing 60 servings and a full 2-month supply, formulated with MCT oil for smooth delivery.

Magnesium is an essential mineral found throughout the body. This formula provides a 900 mg magnesium blend per serving alongside L-theanine, an amino acid naturally found in tea, and ashwagandha, a botanical with a long history of use in traditional Ayurvedic practice.
Designed for daily use, this all-in-one men's magnesium supplement brings complementary ingredients together in one convenient serving for a more streamlined routine.
Non-GMO and manufactured in a cGMP-compliant facility. Third-party lab tested for quality and consistency. Free of soy, dairy, and gluten.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
